summary: The CPU sampler now accepts the exact complete header pair that macOS iostat can repeat between its boot-average and interval rows. It still requires exactly two measured data rows and preserves every production admission threshold.

diagnosis.confirmed_parser_defect: A valid six-line iostat output containing header + boot row + same complete header + interval row is counted as four readings and rejected.
diagnosis.reproducer: Spawn /usr/sbin/iostat -c 2 -w 1 -n 0, send SIGCONT immediately after stdout contains the initial header pair and boot row, then pass its completed stdout to the real cpuBusyFraction parser.
diagnosis.red_result: Actual macOS command exited 0 and emitted six lines; original parser threw RESOURCE_MEASUREMENT_INVALID:cpu-busy:sample-count. New captured-output regression test failed with that exact error before the repair.
diagnosis.green_real_command: Same real-command reproducer emitted the repeated header shape and parsed its final idle=87 as busy=0.13.
diagnosis.source_mechanism: SIGCONT sets phdr_flag; device arrival and termination notifications also set phdr_flag; the next sampling iteration reprints the complete header before its data row, including with -n 0.

hypotheses.prediction: Exact complete repeated header pair reproduces sample-count despite two valid data rows
hypotheses.result: Confirmed using real macOS iostat; narrow normalization turns the original loop green

hypotheses.prediction: One data row must continue to refuse

hypotheses.result: Scratch real guard refuses RESOURCE_CPU_BUSY at unchanged production threshold
